<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="the-zamorakian-undercity" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>The Zamorakian Undercity</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wxxJh3f.jpg" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="introduction"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Zamorak, Lord of Chaos is the fifth and final instalment in the Elder God Wars. This guide will primarily focus on clearing the dungeon segment, for help defeating the boss visit </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-notes-for-senntisten-undercity-zamorak"><ins><nowiki>General Notes for Senntisten Undercity + Zamorak</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lucky charms for the dungeon can be bought from Thoksdottir at Daemonheim</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><strong><nowiki>LOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> of mobs can be ignored throughout the dungeon, but note that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Menders and Dark Wizards will heal mobs/drain your adrenaline</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The only required minibosses are the Jailer on the second floor (who teleports to different floors after 50k damage dealt x Team Size) and Eterna being the second boss before Zamorak.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A Demon / Greater Demon slayer task will affect a great number of mobs present in the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kuradal offers the best chance for this task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><em><ins><nowiki>DISCLAIMER: Presets below have been made for both the dungeon and boss based on preliminary knowledge. This will change as more information becomes available. Upgrade as you see fit, the gear posted below is merely the minimum we suggest.</nowiki></ins></em></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is assumed that Zuk capes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmej" title="igneouskalmej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalket" title="igneouskalket" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for your chosen style, Disruption Shield </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and passive Ring of Vigour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are unlocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All gear used is based on Stage 1 of </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki>, with the addition of the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged skillcape on Anachronia cape stand/Max Cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Igneous Kal-Xil </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength skillcape on Anachronia cape stand/Max Cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (For effect while wearing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalket" title="igneouskalket" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• City of Senntisten spells </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="dungeon-floor-overview"><ins><nowiki>Dungeon Floor Overview</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JC5C0F9.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mefis-the-jailer"><ins><nowiki>Mefis the Jailer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/sZ3U9n3.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Mefis the Jailer is the first boss of the dungeon, this boss is a typical &quot;mini-boss&quot; styled encounter, dealing magic auto-attacks and low upfront damage to the player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>


</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Mefis will teleport to different floors after </nowiki><strong><nowiki>(50k damage dealt X Team Size)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><em><nowiki>(ex: see </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/rs3-full-boss-guides/zamorak/zamorak-dungeon/$linkmsg_dungeonfloors$ <nowiki>this link</nowiki>]<nowiki> for locations)</nowiki></em><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Damage Scaling</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>• 1 Person: 50k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 2 People: 100k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 3 People: 150k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 4 People: 200k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 5 People: 250k Damage before the jailer teleports
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="unlocking-eternas-door"><ins><nowiki>Unlocking Eterna's Door</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To unlock Eterna's doorway you must find two crystal pylon locations see </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dungeon Floor Overview Section</nowiki></strong><nowiki> for the respective locations</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="eterna"><ins><nowiki>Eterna</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wgsSSmr.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Eterna is the last boss of the dungeon, this boss has multiple high hitting mechanics and does alternating magic / ranged auto-attacks throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Deal damage until Eterna phases
    • Eterna will spawn a single Chaos Demon Savage after phasing, kill them to move into phase 2.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Eterna re-appears with full HP along with spawning spiked-circles on the ground, deal damage until phase HP again to move on.
    • Circles can be dealt with by using defensives or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Magic bombs will also spawn from the red portal in the center dealing low magic damage.
⬥ Two Chaos Demon Savages will spawn kill them to proceed to phase 3.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Eterna re-appears with all mechanics listed previously, deal damage until she is dead to move on to the next room.
⬥ The red portal in the center fires a spout into the player, dealing no damage and placing a bar over their head.
    • When this bar depletes, a 5x5 area around the player will become engulfed in smoke, dealing more damage the longer you stand inside.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
